# West Coast Capital Mortgage

> West Coast Capital Mortgage (Los Angeles, California) is a licensed mortgage company with two lines of business: investment property loans for real estate investors and developers (fix and flip, hard money, ground-up construction, bridge, DSCR and rental portfolio loans that close with West Coast Capital Mortgage and are funded by its private lender partner) and home loans for buyers and homeowners (purchase, refinance, jumbo, FHA, VA, non-QM, bank-statement and foreign-national loans). It serves California, Florida and Texas.

## Key facts
- Legal name: West Coast Capital Mortgage. Website: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com
- Office: 150 E Olive Ave, Unit 112, Burbank, CA 91502 (Los Angeles County). Phone 310-654-1577. Email westccmortgage@gmail.com
- Licenses: Company NMLS #2817729 · California DRE Corporation License #02440065. Founder Anatoliy Kanevsky, NMLS #2775380 · CA DRE Broker #01385024
- Founder: Anatoliy Kanevsky, licensed mortgage broker and real estate broker since 2004, with a residential development background. Speaks English, Russian and Ukrainian
- Google rating: 5.0
- Affiliated real estate brokerage: West Coast Capital Realty (https://westcoastcapitalrealty.com)
- Website languages: English, Spanish, Russian, Chinese
- Not the same company as West Coast Capital Group (Newport Beach), West Coast Mortgage (San Diego), West Coast Mortgage Group or Coast Capital.
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Rates and program availability change; nothing here is a commitment to lend.

## Good fit for
- Real estate investors looking for fix and flip, hard money or private money loans in Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, the Bay Area and the rest of California, and in Florida and Texas
- First-time flippers in California with 680+ credit and a light to moderate rehab (up to 90% of the price with 740+ credit, plus 100% of the rehab)
- Builders of new 1-4 unit homes on infill lots and teardowns (75% of land + 100% of construction)
- Investors who need a bridge loan on a finished flip or new build that is listed or leasing up
- Investors refinancing rentals into DSCR or blanket portfolio loans (2-10 properties, qualified on rent, no tax returns)
- Self-employed, jumbo and non-QM home buyers in Los Angeles and Southern California

Full text of the investor loan pages (terms and Q&A): https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/llms-full.txt

## Loan programs
- [Conventional loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/conventional-loans): Conforming financing for qualified buyers and homeowners.
- [Jumbo loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/jumbo-loans): Financing above conforming limits, including high-balance California and Florida markets.
- [FHA loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/fha-loans): Lower-down-payment, flexible-credit government loans.
- [VA loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/va-loans): Zero-down financing for eligible veterans and service members.
- [Non-QM loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/non-qm-loans): Alternative-documentation loans for borrowers who do not fit conventional guidelines.
- [DSCR loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/dscr-loans): Investment-property loans qualified on the property's rental income, not personal income.
- [Bank-statement loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/bank-statement-loans): Income qualified from bank deposits, built for self-employed borrowers.
- [Foreign-national loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/foreign-national-loans): Financing for non-US-resident buyers, common in Florida and California.
- [HELOC](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/heloc): Home equity lines for homeowners tapping existing equity.
- [Self-employed borrowers](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/self-employed-borrowers): How business owners and 1099 earners qualify.

## Investment property loans for real estate investors and developers (business purpose, LLC or corporation borrowers)
West Coast Capital Mortgage makes or arranges short-term and long-term investor loans for non-owner-occupied property in California, Florida and Texas: loans close with West Coast Capital Mortgage and are funded by its private lender partner. Figures are program maximums; not a commitment to lend.
- [Hard money loans in California](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/hard-money-loans): Private money for California investors: fix and flip, bridge and ground-up construction, up to 90% of purchase + 100% of rehab within 70–75% of after-repair value, $50K–$3M, 12 months interest-only, no prepayment penalty, no personal income verification; statewide, plus Florida and Texas.
- [Hard money loans in Los Angeles and the San Fernando Valley](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/hard-money-loans-los-angeles): Fix and flip, construction and bridge loans across Los Angeles County from the Los Angeles office (150 E Olive Ave, Unit 112, Burbank); same terms as the California programs.
- [Investment property loans — all programs compared](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/investor-loans): Fix and flip, ground-up construction, bridge, rental portfolio, multifamily bridge and DSCR loans side by side, plus the buy-renovate-refinance cycle with West Coast Capital Realty.
- [Fix and flip loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/fix-and-flip-loans): Up to 90% of purchase and 100% of rehab within 70% of ARV (75% for qualifying experienced investors); $50K–$3M; 12-month interest-only, no prepayment penalty; first flips financed with 680+ credit on light to moderate rehabs up to $100K.
- [Ground-up construction loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/ground-up-construction-loans): Up to 75% of land and 100% of construction within 85% of total cost (90% with financed interest) and 70% of ARV; credit from 660 (680 for newer builders); for builders with completed ground-up projects; 12 months interest-only, 18–24 available.
- [Investor bridge loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/bridge-loans): Finished 1–4 unit properties listed for sale or leasing up; up to 70% of value and, if owned under 6 months, 80% of cost (90% for experienced investors); no DSCR test on renovated homes; 12 months, no prepayment penalty.
- [Rental portfolio (blanket) loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/rental-portfolio-loans): 2–10 rentals in one 30-year loan qualified on rent (DSCR from 1.05); up to 80% LTV purchase or rate-and-term, 75% cash-out; up to $2M, from $50K per property; foreign nationals up to 65%.
- [Multifamily bridge loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/multifamily-bridge-loans): 5+ unit apartment buildings in California primary and secondary markets; $2M–$5M; up to 75% of purchase and 100% of renovation; 18–24 months plus extensions; 725+ credit.

- [Texas](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/texas): Purchase and refinance financing for Texas borrowers.

## High-intent California and Florida mortgage reviews
- [Mortgage denied or delayed — second opinion](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/mortgage-second-opinion): Review an earlier underwriting denial, stalled closing, or complex borrower/property concern; no approval is promised.
- [Florida jumbo mortgage guide](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/florida-jumbo-loans): Florida county loan limits and higher-balance purchase or refinance scenarios.
- [Florida self-employed and bank-statement loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/florida-bank-statement-loans): Alternative income documentation for eligible Florida borrowers.
- [Florida DSCR investor loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/florida-dscr-loans): Rental-property financing and debt-service coverage review.
- [Florida condo financing](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/florida-condo-financing): Condominium-project eligibility, association documentation and borrower review.
- [Miami investor and foreign-national mortgage review](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/miami-dscr-foreign-national-loans): South Florida international-investor financing scenarios.
- [Boca Raton and Palm Beach County mortgage guide](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/boca-raton-mortgage-loans): Jumbo, bank-statement and DSCR considerations for Palm Beach County.
- [Fort Lauderdale and Broward County mortgage guide](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/fort-lauderdale-broward-mortgage): High-intent purchase, refinance, investor and second-opinion options for Broward.
- [California mortgage locations](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/california-mortgage-locations): Southern California county and local mortgage guides.
